ftf_exclusions.jpa/auto_optimize: FTF does not model a JPA and has no JPA pump RF or flux device.
ftf_exclusions.jpa/check: FTF does not model a JPA or expose an RF device to toggle its pump.
ftf_exclusions.jpa/flux: FTF does not model a JPA or expose a JPA flux device.
ftf_exclusions.jpa/flux_onetone: FTF does not model a JPA or expose a JPA flux device.
ftf_exclusions.jpa/freq: FTF has no pump RF device or JPA response to pump frequency.
ftf_exclusions.jpa/power: FTF has no pump RF device or JPA response to pump power.
